# What's In Your Network?

> We help small offices in Maryland, Washington DC and Northern Virginia find out what phone lines and network equipment they are running on, and get every call answered with an AI receptionist.

Led by Rodrigue Dossouvi (Germantown, Maryland), a phone systems consultant with over 22 years of experience. The AI receptionist is built and run by CallDirector AI.

## Contact
- Phone: (301) 973-6811
- Email: hello@whatsinyournetwork.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern. Closed weekends.
- Service area: Maryland, Washington DC, Northern Virginia
- Hear an AI receptionist answer (demo line, any time): (240) 852-1600

## Services and prices
- [Network Age Check](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/network-age-check/): free. A few questions about phone lines, phone system, router and after-hours calls, with a plain grade (current, aging or end of life).
- [AI receptionist](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/services/ai-receptionist/): $299 setup, then $197 a month. Answers the main number day and night, takes caller details, hands off to the team. Plans start with 60 days, then month to month with 30 days' notice. Live in 5 business days or the setup fee back.
- [Network Assessment](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/services/network-assessment/): every phone line and device mapped. Included free with an AI receptionist, or $295 on its own.
- [Copper phone line changes](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/services/copper-line-replacement/): we find what is plugged into a small office's copper phone lines and work with the phone provider on the switch. Covered in the Network Assessment.
- [Office phone system upgrade](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/services/phone-system-upgrade/): we identify the phone system, map the numbers and write the list to take to the phone provider. Covered in the Network Assessment.
- [All services](https://whatsinyournetwork.com/services/)
